_note: Story 057b: the small rewards (Salon Besties' own look and sounds). progress.linesPerPhase: player lines that fill one phase's share of the appointment bar (it never fills a phase before the phase moves on). perfect.showMs: how long the Perfect badge shows (story 061 grades decide when it shows). bursts: how many coins or confetti pieces fly, and for how long. reactMs: how long the companion keeps a cheering or sad face. None of the motion plays with Reduce motion. results (story 057c): countMs, how long +XP, +coins and +$ count up on the results; streakDelayMs, when the streak chip pops after the count starts. grades (story 061): every line gets one of four grades from the line check. A line with a real fix is 'try' (the fix waits on the companion's badge); a small fix (the better line shares at least 1 - smallFixShare of its words with hers) is still 'good'. With nothing to fix: perfectWords or more English words is 'perfect' (confetti), fewer is 'great'. A helped line, or one too short to check, is 'good'.
